prompt: Create a restrained, polished background surface for a Japanese publication profile card, landscape 1179x540. Match the native reference’s calm pale mint green (#ECFDF5) and generous centered editorial hierarchy. This is a BACKGROUND ONLY: no text, no letters, no logo, no icon, no photo, no card UI, no border, no button, no decoration, no pattern, no gradients with visible bands. Use a nearly flat pale mint field with only a very faint, soft tonal shift toward the edges, smooth and clean. Leave the center open and evenly lit so a supplied square publication mark can be placed in the upper center and Japanese title and action labels can be typeset below. Contemporary Japanese independent publication aesthetic, quiet, warm, uncluttered, accessible contrast when dark text is added. Do not include any additional objects or visual elements.
